# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_FAIL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

If price opens below the opening range low and fails to retest VWAP within the first 30 minutes, intraday bias is bearish, offering a short entry. This edge exists because failure to reclaim VWAP after an OR-low open indicates weak buying pressure and continuation of the morning's bearish imbalance.

## Mechanism

Calculate the opening range (OR) high/low from the first 5‑min bar after 09:30 ET. If the open price is <= OR low, then monitor the next six 5‑min bars (09:30‑10:00). If the price never touches or crosses above the VWAP (calculated from session start) during that window, enter short at the close of the 10:00 bar. Exit: Stop placed at the OR high; target 1R; if price reaches 0.5R, move stop to break‑even and then trail with a 12‑period EMA. Regime filters: ATR(5) between 0.3% and 0.8% of price, VIX between 12 and 22; avoid gap‑up days or major news windows.
